recoveryTitleWithDetail: {{label}} — {{detail}}. Open the source task to act.
recoveryTitle: {{label}} — open the source task to act.
retryNowHint: Paperclip will ask the assignee to choose the next step {{schedule}}. Retry now starts that follow-up immediately.
inFlight: A correction run is in progress — the agent is working. This alert returns if the run stops without choosing a next step.

live.title: Waiting on live work
live.queued_one: Queued behind {{count}} task being worked in order. This task resumes automatically when the chain is done. Comments still notify the assignee.
live.queued_other: Queued behind {{count}} tasks being worked in order. This task resumes automatically when the chain is done. Comments still notify the assignee.
live.thisTask: This task — resumes automatically when the chain is done

handoff.title: This task still needs a next step.
handoff.body: A run finished successfully, but the task is still open. Paperclip needs someone to choose what happens next.
handoff.option2: Send it for review or ask for input.
handoff.option3: Record what is blocking it and who owns that blocker.
handoff.option4: Delegate follow-up work or queue a continuation.
handoff.asked: Asked {{name}} to choose the next step

blocked.stalledMany: Work on this task is blocked by {{blockers}}, but the chain is stalled in review without a clear next step. Resolve the stalled reviews below or remove them as blockers.
blocked.stalledOne: Work on this task is blocked by {{blockers}}, but the chain is stalled in review without a clear next step. Resolve the stalled review below or remove it as a blocker.
blocked.reopenSuppressed_one: A message won’t restart this task yet — it stays blocked by the linked task until it is done, then it reopens automatically. Comments still notify {{name}} for questions or triage in the meantime.
blocked.reopenSuppressed_other: A message won’t restart this task yet — it stays blocked by the linked tasks until they are done, then it reopens automatically. Comments still notify {{name}} for questions or triage in the meantime.
blocked.byLinked_one: Work on this task is blocked by the linked task until it is complete. Comments still notify the assignee for questions or triage.
blocked.byLinked_other: Work on this task is blocked by the linked tasks until they are complete. Comments still notify the assignee for questions or triage.
blocked.untilMovedBack: Work on this task is blocked until someone moves it back to To do. Comments still notify the assignee for questions or triage.
